name: Flite Test Mighty Mini F-22
summary: Foam-board pusher jet, 508 mm. Prop in a slot in the wing, elevons, canted fins. Hand launch. 2204 2600Kv, 5x4.5 five-blade, 3S 800 mAh, 211 g.

notes.units: Units: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds; angles in degrees where the name ends in 'Deg'. 'tuning' holds built-in changes in the Tuning tab's terms (paste an Export's "tuning" here).
notes.about: Flite Test Mighty Mini F-22, traced off the plan sheets.
notes.prop: A 2204 2600Kv on 3S (~29,000 rpm unloaded) with a 5x4.5 five-blade quad prop, loaded to ~22,000 rpm: about 510 g static thrust at ~16 A (estimated from typical 5" prop data). pitchSpeed = pitch × loaded rpm, so it is faster flat out than the plan's 2300Kv and 6x4.5.
notes.throws: Elevons 25° each way on the plan, for roll and pitch. Mixed, they share the 25° of servo travel.
notes.stallAsymmetryDeg: The left wing stalls this much earlier.
notes.reflexDeg: Elevons trimmed trailing edge up: the plan's reflex gauge.
notes.aeroDihedralDeg: Effective dihedral for the aerodynamics (the wing is flat): the swept leading edge and the fins standing above the wing roll it away from a sideslip.
notes.colors: Painted in two greys like the full-size Raptor, with a gold-tinted canopy.
